thread:
sophie: Heads-up — NeptuneAnalytics just flagged they were billed for Dedicated capacity after they terminated the reservation on 2025-11-01. Invoice INV-9832 shows a full month charge. Can finance take a look?

billing-bot: [automated] Invoice INV-9832 attached (2025-11-15). Amount: $18,400. Line item: Dedicated Reserved Capacity — Nov 2025.
aj: Thanks Sophie. Do we have the termination request/confirmation timestamp from sales or support? Want to confirm their cancel date before any adjustment.
devon: I have the support ticket: #54321 — customer requested termination on 2025-11-02 and we confirmed on 2025-11-03. Billing cycle started 2025-11-01. Looks like overlap.
oliver: They hit an onboarding bug that prevented us from finishing the Dedicated provisioning, so they canceled. Recommend we do a goodwill adjustment (waive the full month) + prorated refund for the overlap.
fran: Before committing to anything — need clear numbers and GL impact. Also, do we require an exec approval for >$5k credits?
devon: Proposal below (rough):

```
Invoice INV-9832: $18,400
Prorated charge for 2 days (11/01-11/03): $1,100 (customer already charged full month)
Proposed actions:
- Reverse full month Dedicated charge: -$18,400
- Apply proration re-charge for 2 days: +$1,100
- Goodwill onboarding credit: -$5,200
Net adjustment (credit to customer): -$22,500
GL impacts: use AR-Adj (6101) + PromoCredits (7420)
```

Numbers assume monthly commit = $18,400. If we instead waive only the termination fee and give partial credit, let me know.
aj: If net credit is $22.5k we need VP approval. Fran — can you sign off? Also confirm cost center: COGS-Redwood-Dedicated.
fran: I approve the goodwill credit and waive termination fee. Approved for up to $25k. :white_check_mark: Please tag COGS-Redwood-Dedicated and note as "onboarding-failure" for reporting.
billing-bot: [automated] Adjustment created ADJ-4572. Credits applied: $22,500. Updated invoice published: INV-9832-v2.pdf. Accounting refs: ADJ-4572 / AR-6101 / PROMO-7420.
sophie: Great — I'll notify NeptuneAnalytics and copy legal. Oliver, want to send the external note? Keep it short and empathetic.
oliver: Drafted message below — please review: "Hi team — we're very sorry for the onboarding issue. We've applied a $22,500 credit to your account and republished your invoice (INV-9832-v2). No termination fee. If you'd like us to re-provision Dedicated, we'll prioritize your rollout. — Oliver, Account Exec"
aj: Looks good. Add a sentence about the credit appearing on next billing cycle, and include contact for escalation.
oliver: Updated and sent. Customer replied: "Appreciate the quick response — thanks." Closing ticket.
sophie: Thanks everyone. Closing this thread.
